name: 2.6.3 - Map COSTAR
notes: Map COSTAR: a Map COSTAR screen button in the RDP helper. Press it, bring up the COSTAR screen within 5 s, and the helper reads it (never clicks or types): every box, button, tick box, tab, list and menu, and what can be pressed directly. The maps go with Save diagnostics. Update the RDP helper; no website files.
